hints.title: Zero Detection and Parity
hints.text: If any value is 0, the entire product becomes 0 immediately.

hints.title: Count Negative Numbers
hints.text: The sign depends only on the parity of the count of negative numbers in the array.

hints.title: Sign Value Mapping
hints.text: If the count of negative numbers is odd, return -1, otherwise return 1.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Computing the actual product causes arithmetic overflow for large arrays.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Counting negative values and zero occurrences avoids large multiplications in O(n) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate avoids computing large product directly to prevent integer overflow.
